::: {#exm-triangles}
#### Circuits and cycles in three triangles

@fig-triangles draws a simple graph (@def-simple-graph) $T$ made of three triangles in a row.
In $T$:

- $1, 2, 3, 1$ is a cycle (@def-graph-cycle) of length 3;
- $3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 5, 3$ is a circuit (@def-circuit) of length 6, since its six edges are all different.
  It is not a cycle, since it visits $5$ twice before it comes back to $3$.

In the office graph (@fig-office), $b, d, f, e, c, b$ is a cycle of length 5.
